candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.role_title: Working Student Data Analysis in Battery Development
letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in Data Analysis in Battery Development. Querying, pre-processing and presenting product-usage data to engineers is the core of the role, and it matches what I have done with production data.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. I worked in SAP data and analytics at TallyMarks Consulting and as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea.

achievements.impact: I rebuilt a manufacturer's spinning dashboard end to end, covering OEE, machine efficiency and utilization, downtime and yield
I query and validate data in SQL and build Python pipelines, most recently for DocuMind, an evaluated RAG application
I documented data sources, calculations and results for every dashboard I built

letter.problems_section: I would query and pre-process battery and tool usage data, analyse it with Python and SQL and present clear insights to the development teams. I have not used PySpark or Microsoft Fabric yet, and my battery knowledge is basic; both are things I want to learn in this role.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Munich and can work up to 20 hours per week, starting immediately. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
